inputFile.description: The file to read the game names from.

fileName.description: The name of the file to read the game names from.

fileType.description: The file type of the input file. Choose from any of the supported file types listed.

delimiter.description: The delimiter between game names in the input file. If omitted, defaults to a newline for "txt" files and a comma for "csv" files.

onlyFullMatches.description: Whether to only get Steam App IDs for full matches or also for partial matches. If set to false, partial matches will be saved to a different output file.

steamAPIKey.description: Your Steam Web API key. You can get one for free here: https://steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. Required because Steam retired the keyless "ISteamApps/GetAppList" endpoint; this mode now uses "IStoreService/GetAppList", which needs an API key.

partialMatchThreshold.description: The threshold for partial matches. This means that the most similar game name must have a similarity score of at least this threshold to be added to the output. The threshold must be between 0 and 1. Use 0 to get a match for every game and 1 to only get full matches (case insensitive). If the value is omitted, a match will be found for every game.
